mechanism.claim: After a causally high-variation completed BTC eight-hour cycle, lower quadratic variation in the second four hours together with unchanged return direction and higher directional efficiency indicates volatility decay into price acceptance; follow that accepted direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: common strict sign of Binance perpetual and FX-adjusted Upbit completed returns
mechanism.why_distinct: HVKPLC uses within-cycle variance decay and an efficiency ordering. Prior temporal-variance ignition concentrated variance late over a 24-hour daily clock; this candidate requires the opposite variance ordering on fixed eight-hour cycles and reuses no event set or control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the completed eight-hour variation must rank in its causal upper 35 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: FX-adjusted Korean cash leadership is absent from Gross9 primitives

features.cycle: 480 exact coherent BTCUSDT bars_binance interval=1m rows [D-8h,D)
features.minute_return: ln(close/open) for each completed minute; finite
features.binance_return: sum of 480 one-minute Binance perpetual ln(close/open) returns, strict nonzero
features.upbit_krw_return: sum of synchronized 480 one-minute Upbit KRW-BTC ln(close/open) returns, strict nonzero
features.usdkrw_return: ln(close[D-1m]/open[D-8h]) from exact bars_polygon USDKRW endpoint rows; no fill
features.direction_agreement: binance_return and upbit_implied_usd_return have one strict sign
features.korean_price_leadership: sign(binance_return)*(upbit_implied_usd_return-binance_return)>0, strict with no fitted magnitude threshold
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid cycles; current excluded; minimum 180; rank>=0.65
features.onset: eligible now and immediately prior exact source-valid cycle ineligible; missing prior opportunity cannot trigger

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact held settlements only after source and Gross9 pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.bars: Postgres bars_binance BTCUSDT, bars_upbit KRW-BTC, and bars_polygon USDKRW exact one-minute endpoint data
source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 pass

research_boundary.classification: exploratory discovery; not fresh confirmatory evidence

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no endpoint synchronization, FX adjustment, Korean leadership ordering, variation history, side, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
